about_the_game: A hilarious night of comedy with five of the funniest Indian stand-up comedians! Blowing aside political correctness, these talented Indian comics break down stereotypes as they cover politics, racism, dating, childhood, pop-culture, and being a gay Indian in America. Starring Vidur Kapur, Vijai Nathan, Mark Saldana, Dalia McPhee, Rajiv Satyal.

About the Video

A hilarious night of comedy with five of the funniest Indian stand-up comedians! Blowing aside political correctness, these talented Indian comics break down stereotypes as they cover politics, racism, dating, childhood, pop-culture, and being a gay Indian in America. Starring Vidur Kapur, Vijai Nathan, Mark Saldana, Dalia McPhee, Rajiv Satyal.
